project.name: Acme Catalog Service (PHP → Java 21 / Spring Boot 3 migration)
project.description:
Reference PHP → Java-21 / Spring Boot 3 scaffold for an Acme storefront cart/pricing slice, generated from a signed php spec (spec/v1, schemaId=php, targetStack=java-spring). Demonstrates the PHP→static-type idiom gap: loose == juggling ⟶ explicit typed comparison, the PHP array-as-ordered-map ⟶ a record + Map, isset/empty/?? ⟶ Optional/nullable (WITHOUT the empty("0") bug), the $_SESSION superglobal ⟶ an injected SessionCartPort, money-as-float ⟶ BigDecimal, and @-suppressed failures ⟶ explicit typed exceptions.
Builds OFFLINE through the maven-sidecar (pinned plugins + junit/assertj only, no framework on the classpath) — the Spring constructs are documented @TargetMapping contracts and the pure business logic is real Java the JUnit suite verifies. PHP has a free runtime, so source-execution equivalence is FEASIBLE via a future php-sidecar, but that is not built — so equivalence is NOT claimed; the golden score + this suite are the gates.
Sibling archetype dotnet8/canonical-php-catalog-service is the .NET 8 projection of the same signed spec (the SME picks the target per routine).
